wa_starfish.notes: WHERE IT IS: on the upper left end of the Blues Cliff, at its top edge; its anchors (chains) sit just below the viewpoint where the Mid Wall trail meets the cliff edge, a few feet from #9's, and climbers rappel in from there. Mountain Project files it under Blues Cliff; the guide files the combined entry "#9 and Starfish" (5.9, Trad, 4 stars) under Mid Wall because it is reached from the Mid Wall trail. They are two separate adjacent lines (MP pages for each; the guide only describes them together). Our filing under Blues Cliff matches the rock; report only, nothing moved. Grade: the guide's 5.9 is for the combined entry (MP grades #9 5.10a), so it is not counted as a second source for Starfish alone. guide_stars: the guide's 4 stars belong to the combined entry, not proposed. Anchor: MP route page says chains (via the #9 page), but a photo caption on the Starfish page reports a red-tagged loose hanger and a rusty bolt buried in dirt at the anchors, so no anchor type proposed; worth a condition note. Length not stated. FA unknown (MP).
